# plerion_tenant (Data Source)

The Plerion tenant the API key belongs to. Use `external_id` in the trust policy of the IAM roles Plerion assumes.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "plerion_tenant" "this" {}

output "external_id" {
  value = data.plerion_tenant.this.external_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) External id Plerion sends when it assumes a role in your account. Reading it needs a key whose role can modify integrations.
- `name` (String) Tenant name.
- `organization_id` (String) Id of the Plerion organization the tenant belongs to.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant id.
